instrumentation: Ephemeral init observers wrap Storage mutations and IndexedDB object-store writes without changing arguments/results. A context binding retains bounded mutation/lifecycle metadata across reload. A separate task-owned preview serves a hashed observation-only app projection over frozen runtime with fixture credentials and public,max-age=0,must-revalidate headers. No Playwright routing is installed; only /game/app.mjs and /game/presentation/host.mjs are projected by the preview; a minimal away page is served by this test-only server.
limitations: Observation-only clone adds bounded boot transitions and failure/success snapshot fields for menu geometry, hit targets, warnings and focus. Runtime, flow, conditions and all existing timeouts are unchanged. This diagnostic is not a replacement qualification pass.
Reload is not browser discard; no actual discard is claimed.
BFCache is proved only by pageshow.persisted=true and the original document identity; failed admission is reported separately.

Solo explicitly suspends Demo on pagehide, including persisted history navigation, in inherited upstream app.mjs behavior. A paused watching return documents that policy; it does not prove preservation of playing intent through freeze/resume.
Fresh ephemeral test profiles exercise ordinary entry and compare a control reload. This does not replay every possible saved-game recovery state.
Read/write observers detect API calls, not every browser-internal storage mechanism. Existing persistence and saved-flight tests remain complementary.

Background managed-media asset-cache writes (game/managed-media-store.mjs) are recorded separately from player progress, saves, recovery and tuning; the ordinary app can preload those assets independently of Demo.

presentationProjection.scope: Bounded main/fetch admission and native result side observers; no new awaited result and no admission/deadline change.

projection.scope: Only incoming handoff stage observation calls and a read-only snapshot closure; original awaits and rejection behavior preserved.
